out_of_scope_observations.observation: handleSidebarDrop deselects accommodation slot without calling preserveCurrentAccommodationOption. Edge case: if the user's INITIAL hotel is the PLAN hotel (not a v2 candidate), and the user drags it OUT without first dragging any candidate IN, the PLAN hotel will not be in options[] and will not reappear in the Candidates panel. The bridge/applyBridge calls ensure the hotel is preserved when a CANDIDATE is swapped IN first (the primary user flow described in the complaint). However the symmetric drag-out-of-initial-PLAN-hotel path is not guarded. This is outside AC3 literal scope (which requires only bridge + applyBridge calls) but is a real edge case.

pre-patch had 3) - `grep -F 'style={candidateCardStyle('` scoped to L2390-2560 → 3 matches (PASS) - Helper definition at L2264: returns `borderRadius: '8px'`, boxShadow varies by isSelected/isPending **AC2 (cover_image fallback):** - opt.image && o.option_id === selectedAccId)) return;` - v2-shaped synth object confirmed: name, name_local, location_summary, cover_image, image **AC4 (draggable):** - `grep draggable` L1260-1290 → 1 match (`draggable={!!dragOptionId}`) - `grep -E 'direction.*board'` L1265-1290 → 1 match - null-guard `edAcc = editorDay && editorDay.accommodation` at L1265 confirmed **AC5 (sourceSlotId + direction:board):** - `grep -E 'sourceSlotId.*accommodation'` L1265-1290 → 1 match - `grep -E 'direction.*board'` L1265-1290 → 1 match **AC6 (backward-compat):** - `grep 'editorDay && editorDay.accommodation'` L1260-1280 → 1 match **pytest:** 6 passed in 0.03s (test_AC1 through test_AC6, all sentinel-free) **Live Playwright E2E on https://travel.life-ai.app/trip/beijing-lijiang-dali-20260418-100846 (6/6 checks pass):** - AC1: Computed borderRadius=8px, background=rgb(255,255,255) on candidate cards — Kanban-consistent - AC1: Selected card: background=rgb(233,245,236) (green tint) — correct selected state - AC2: Accommodation slot card has img element with naturalWidth=250 (base64 SVG from cover_image fallback) - AC4: data-slot-card=primary [data-slot-id=accommodation] has draggable=true in live DOM - AC4: Candidate cards data-option-id=accommodation-1-1 and accommodation-1-2 also draggable=true - AC6: Zero JS errors on page load - Screenshots: /tmp/qa-e2e-initial-1440.png (desktop 1440x900), /tmp/qa-e2e-initial-390.png (mobile 390x844) **Codex adversarial review findings:** - BLOCKER (classified as out-of-scope edge case): `handleSidebarDrop` at L2346 does not call `preserveCurrentAccommodationOption` before clearing selection. This affects the edge case where user drags the initial PLAN hotel OUT without first dragging any candidate IN. Primary user scenario (drag candidate IN, old hotel reappears) is unaffected. - MINOR: `candidateCardStyle` at L2269-2271 uses blue boxShadow (`#3b82f6`) for selected state; visual convention is green (`#45b26b`) to match checkmark/border colors. No effect on functionality.

code_quality_findings.issue: candidateCardStyle boxShadow for selected state uses blue ring (#3b82f6) but the selected-state visual convention in the panel uses green (#45b26b) for border, background tint, and checkmark. Inconsistency means the blue focus ring conflicts with the green selected indicator on the same card.
code_quality_findings.recommendation: Change boxShadow value from '0 0 0 2px #3b82f6' to '0 0 0 2px #45b26b' in candidateCardStyle to match the green selected-state convention.

code_quality_findings.issue: useEffect deps array is [publishedDay && publishedDay.day, saveMutations, editorDay]. preserveCurrentAccommodationOption reads editorSelections from closure but editorSelections is not in deps. This is a pre-existing pattern in the bridge useEffect, not introduced by this cycle. At event-handler invocation time editorSelections reflects last-rendered state (correct for the intended use), so this is a lint concern rather than a runtime bug for this use case.
code_quality_findings.recommendation: Monitor for React StrictMode double-invocation issues. If editorSelections is ever observed stale, add it to deps array. Not blocking for this cycle as the pattern pre-exists and the event-handler timing is correct.

codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: BLOCKER classified as out-of-scope edge case per AC3 literal text (which specifies only bridge + applyBridge) and per Anti-Fraud Principle 7 (cycle scope vs bug scope). The primary user scenario — drag candidate IN, then drag OUT — is fully covered because bridge already pushed the PLAN hotel into options[] before the drag-out occurs. The handleSidebarDrop gap only affects the narrow edge case of dragging the initial PLAN hotel OUT before any candidate is dragged IN; this is not the scenario the user described ('拖动进去之后原来的酒店没有了'). Recorded in out_of_scope_observations for next cycle. MINOR boxShadow finding recorded as minor finding in all_findings; not blocking.
